story: At 5:17 on a mild Thursday evening in Sumter Oaks, Gary is at his workbench at home, laying out light strings and sound system parts and testing the wiring, looking content. Donna is at Gary's house too, pleased to have offered her peach cobbler for the Saturday get-together, and Rosa is wrapping up her plans there, heading home to start cooking after confirming beans, rolls, and dessert for six o'clock. Over at Hal's house, Hal is dutifully logging the day's flamingo count in his violation notebook and noting Gary's pending cart filing.
events: Gary (gary workbench): Lay out the light strings and sound system parts and start testing the wiring
Hal (hal violation notebook): Log today's flamingo count and note Gary's pending cart filing

gary.thought_process: Donna and Rosa have both pinned me down for Saturday: dinner at six with the beans and rolls, pickleball at eight sharp. Nothing left to ask or confirm, and repeating myself would just be noise. My real goal is the cart for the parade. The review form is filed, so the legal part is handled, and the wiring is the part I can actually do something about right now. The workbench is right here and I've got daylight left, so I'll get my hands on the lights and quit gabbing.

parameters.content: Lay out the light strings and sound system parts and start testing the wiring

donna.thought_process: Gary and Rosa just finished locking in Saturday dinner, and I already confirmed the 8am doubles with Gary last tick. Asking again would just be nagging. Rosa's right here, so I can be useful and warm: offer to bring something to her dinner, which keeps me at the center of the plan without repeating myself.

parameters.content: Rosa, since Gary's got the beans, let me bring dessert Saturday. I make a peach cobbler that never lasts past the first pass, and I'll bring an extra folding chair just in case.

hal.thought_process: I'm home at last, no one in sight. I counted Donna's flamingos and read the bulletin board, so my notes should be current. Rosa's dinner is Saturday and Gary's filing is pending, so I'd rather keep things friendly than hunt for violations. Still, a sergeant keeps his records straight. I'll log the flamingo count in the notebook before supper so everything is documented properly, and decide afterward whether anything even needs reporting.

parameters.content: Log today's flamingo count and note Gary's pending cart filing

rosa.thought_process: Gary is confirmed with beans and rolls, Donna and Hal are in too, so the guest list is set. I shouldn't ask or confirm again. What's left is my own prep: it's 5:17 PM Thursday, I'm standing in Gary's house, and I need to start shopping and cooking for Saturday. Time to wrap this up and go home to plan the menu.

parameters.content: Alright, you two, I've got a menu to plan and a table to set. Gary, beans and rolls, Donna, dessert, and I'll see you both Saturday at six. I'm heading home to start cooking.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
